card.name: The word time in 'at any time points'
card.fires_on: The word 'time' or a quantifier (any, all, multiple, some, one or more) right after 'at', just before 'time' or 'points'. It appears in clinical-trial results describing measurements at various time points.

modes.label: time before points
modes.description: The word 'time' sits right before 'points' or '-points' in a list of measurement times.
modes.example: though significant reductions were not seen at other<< time>>points.

modes.label: quantifier after at
modes.description: A word like any, all, multiple or some follows 'at' and comes just before 'time'.
modes.example: None of the subjects had a change exceeding 60 msec or a QTcLD exceeding 500 msec at<< any>> time during this study.

card.writes: It promotes 'time', 'point' and 'points' (including Chinese equivalents), so it predicts the next word will be time or point.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'time point' in trial results, such as 'at any' or 'at all'.
